lessons.claim: Build a checker and fail to wire it up and it 'passes silently'. health.py's step_health (the L4→L3 feedback, which the module itself calls 'the core of this module') did not execute in any of 81 runs -- run.Guard put dt·|F|max only inside l4 while tools/health.py was looking for numerics['step_rms_sigma'] (a name mismatch). When absent it printed 'not measured' and returned HEALTHY, so 82/82 HEALTHY read like coverage. The remedy: report the number of unmeasured runs separately, and state that that HEALTHY means only 'no divergence, no freezing, no collapse' and not 'dt is small enough'.
